title: Goose Egg Nests
read_aloud: Grimble flips to a crisp practice page. 'No overcomplication. Clean answers, clean equations, clean magic. Goose Egg Nests begins now.'
printed_instructions: Share equally and write how many in each nest.
Write answers clearly. Use counters only if you are stuck or the page asks for them.
Optional challenge: solve the first pass without counting objects one by one.
layout_description: Black-and-white printable page themed around Goose Egg Nests; open writing space, large text, optional small art border, no dense background.

art.worksheet_art_prompt: Child-friendly cozy fantasy worksheet art for 'Goose Egg Nests': black-and-white line art worksheet border for Goose Egg Nests, fantasy but clean and spacious. Bright storybook adventure style, expressive, non-scary, clear main subject, no text, no numerals, no equations, no copyrighted characters.
art.negative_prompt: no dark horror, no dense background, no tiny writing, no equations embedded in artwork

fail_forward_rule: If this page becomes frustrating, solve one problem together, narrate partial success, and continue. Do not trap the story.
